en: Something in the Uncatalogued Ruins has opened a rift, and the Undead it wakes now guard it.
That marker is an enemy attack winding up. {dash} dashes you clear.
Spells are built from runes. Open a slot at the Sigil Desk to craft one.
3 cards: pick 1. Each card adds a new behaviour to your spells.
Edit slot 4, test it in the range. Invalid spells show why.
Guild prices. No haggling, no credit.
Pick what you need. The Guild keeps the ledger.
Logged. The Guild thanks you for the coin.
Done. Mind the rift on the way out.
Put a rune into an empty slot: open it to edit.
Water makes enemies Wet. Try Lightning.
Deals fire damage and applies Burning to the target.
Deals water damage, applies Wet and puts out Burning.
Deals lightning damage; on a Wet target it arcs once to the nearest other Wet target.
Deals cold damage and applies Chilled; 3 Chilled stacks freeze the target.
Deals force damage and knocks the target back; shatters Frozen targets.
Fires a single bolt in a straight line that ends on its first hit.
Hits every target within a 75-unit radius at once.
Circles you at 72 units for 6 seconds, hitting what it touches.
Channels a line that hits all along it and drains mana each pulse; walls stop it.
Creates a zone at the target that applies its essence to enemies inside for 4 seconds.
Projectile turns toward the nearest target within 280 units.
Projectile fires as 3 bolts spread across 17 degrees.
Projectile passes through targets, hitting up to 3 different ones.
Each hit jumps to 2 more nearby enemies within 160 units, never the same one twice.
Bigger area or longer beam (x1.5), but the spell travels or pulses slower.
Shorter cooldown (x0.6) but deals 30% less damage.
When the projectile hits, it releases its attached Burst payload.
When the spell kills an enemy, it releases its Burst payload at that enemy.
When the effect ends, it releases its Burst payload where it ended.
While the effect lives, it releases its Burst payload every 0.5 seconds.
Basic Bolt: a neutral projectile that deals plain damage, no element.
